name: Star Defender 2
summary:
VR Gesture Roguelike Adventure

Dive into an exhilarating VR world blending survival, defense, and roguelike excitement, where every action is powered by intuitive gestures. Use your hands to cast dynamic spells, fortify strategic defenses, and confront relentless enemies in an ever-changing landscape.

Each playthrough offers unique challenges and procedurally generated environments, pushing your adaptability and strategy to their limits. Unlock and upgrade a vast array of skills, customizing your gameplay
